historicNote: Supercuts' location on Route 66, one of the most famous roads in American history, adds an interesting layer to its character. The salon is part of a vibrant area rich in Pueblo history and cultural heritage.

name: Baskin-Robbins

about: Nestled along the historic Route 66, Baskin-Robbins has been a local favorite for over two decades. name: Don Newton - Taylor Ranch Community Center
description: Discover the heart of Albuquerque's rich history at Don Newton - Taylor Ranch Community Center, a hidden gem in the Kachina Heights neighborhood.
about: Nestled along Route 66, Don Newton - Taylor Ranch Community Center stands as a testament to Albuquerque's past and present. Built in the early 1900s, this historic site has been a cornerstone of community life for generations. The center hosts various events, from cultural festivals to educational workshops, making it a vital hub for locals and visitors alike.
historicNote: The Taylor Ranch Community Center played a significant role in the development of Kachina Heights, reflecting the area's growth from a rural community to a thriving neighborhood.
insiderTip: Don't miss the annual Old Town Fiesta at Don Newton - Taylor Ranch Community Center, where you can experience traditional Pueblo dances and enjoy delicious green chile dishes.
priceNote: Entry is free for most events; check the website for specific details.
parkingInfo: Free parking is available on-site.
